title: 第96章 我哥哥很厉害的！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 与此同时，东虞使馆。东虞正使言锋倒了一杯茶，推到一个穿着白衣，俊逸得近乎妖异的少年面前。“秦钰，老夫知道你日夜兼程赶来大炎很辛苦，但现在我没有太多的时间给你休息了。”“今日就是沈园诗会，大炎皇帝以及京都有头有脸的人物，都会参加。”“我需要你将大炎所有人踩在脚下，你……能做到？”秦钰，东虞京都最出名的才子之一。她还有一个不为人知的身份，东虞三公主，秦书简。秦钰端着茶杯，听完言锋的话眉头皱了皱道：“你送回去的资料，我来的路上已经看过，其他人倒还好说，唯独这小诗仙没有半点资料。”“这么长时间了，你们连小诗仙是谁，都没有查出来吗？”言锋脸皮颤了颤，道：“没查出来，炎文帝将他藏得很好，甚至丢出了唐逸这么一个假目标混淆视听。”“而唐逸，不过是吏部侍郎唐敬的废物儿子而已。”“真正的小诗仙，查的人都死得差不多了。”这段时间，整个京都无数势力，都在查到底谁是小诗仙。但派去查小诗仙的人，都被锦衣卫和御前司给杀光了。不抓活口，不审问，就一个字，杀！秦珏沉吟了一下，道：“罢了，没有便没有吧，今日我倒是要看看，能写出那等慷慨激昂的诗词的小诗仙，到底是何等人物。”“备车吧，我们去沈园。”言锋挥了挥手，门外的下人立即下去备车。“备车，孤要去沈园诗会。”东宫，太子放下手中的书籍，看向洪竹笑道：“今日，我们便去瞧瞧父皇给孤推荐，号称得之可得天下的唐逸，到底有什么本事。”“当初他在天香楼唐画的庆功宴上，半点面子都不给孤，害得孤被父皇申饬。”“今日，孤要亲眼看到他被踩入尘埃。”洪竹恭敬笑道：“殿下必定能如愿以偿。”同一时间，户部尚书刘温，刑部侍郎赵轲等大臣，也都开始向沈园出发。因此午时未到，整个沈园已经热闹非凡，喧嚣不已。锦衣卫千户宁川带着一处的人，亲自核准了所有参加宴会的人的请帖和身份，忙得焦头烂额，大汗淋漓。而这时，唐逸和萧棣还在马车中相拥而眠，昨晚他们两人办事太晚，几乎天亮才回到燕王府，睡了不到一个时辰就被叫起床洗漱了。两人只能让王府的马车慢点驶，在马车上补点觉，恢复点精神。不然，两人顶着熊猫眼出现在沈园诗会，还不得成为笑话？……半个时辰后，唐逸和萧棣终于来到了沈园。“哥哥，你来了，我都等好久了。”唐逸带着哈欠下车，一道小小的身影便已经扑进了他的怀里，生生将他撞得退了两步。“怎么？这才两天不见，就这么想大哥了？”唐逸笑着弯腰将唐音抱了起来，萧棣看着唐音浑身疲惫也是一扫而光，目光在唐音身上转：“呃，你妹？”“对啊，我妹。”唐逸指了指萧棣，给妹妹介绍：“这家伙是当朝四皇子，燕王萧棣，以后有困难，尽管找他。”唐音大眼睛落在萧棣的身上，甜甜叫了一声：“燕王哥哥好，我是唐音。”萧棣睨了一眼唐逸，你还真不客气啊！小女孩燕王哥哥都叫上了，那见面礼肯定得给。他在身上摸索了一圈，结果全身剩下除了绣春刀和象征他身份的玉佩外，就只剩下二十两银子。给钱？啧，二十两拿不出手……他索性摘下了腰间的玉佩，递给了唐音：“音儿真乖，喏，燕王哥哥的见面礼。”唐音没有接，看向唐逸。唐逸笑道：“这种小事，音儿可以自己做决定。”唐音嘴角立即有了笑容，接过玉佩甜甜说了一句：“哥哥赐，不敢辞，音儿谢谢燕王哥哥。”“不，不用谢……”看着唐音收了玉佩，小心翼翼和一枚龙形玉放在一起，萧棣的眉心就直跳。我去，没看错的话，那是父皇的玉佩吗？父皇竟然将自己的随身玉佩，送给了唐音？那可相当于免死金牌啊！“杜姑娘，谢谢了。”唐逸看向站在前方的杜凌菲，微微颔首道：“这几日姑娘照顾唐音，辛苦了，我……”“以身相许就行。”萧棣抢过唐逸的话。唐逸嘴角猛地一抽，杜凌菲想到今日唐音的话，脸上不由滚烫起来。她睨着萧棣，努力维持嘴角的笑容：“许久不见，燕王殿下还是这么随性，看来贤妃娘娘说得对，陛下还是太纵容殿下了。”“晚点回宫的时候，奴婢觉得还是有必要和娘娘汇报一下……”萧棣面色顿时僵住。我去，咋还带告状的呢？杜凌菲已经从唐逸怀中接过唐音，转身进了沈园。唐逸抬手拍了拍萧棣的肩膀，有些幸灾乐祸：“没想到吧？我妹妹还这么小，哈哈哈……”唐逸哪里不知道萧棣的心思？你勾搭我妹妹那我就勾搭你妹妹呗，结果唐音太小了，她只能将目标转移到杜凌菲身上。可杜凌菲是贤妃的女官，某种意义上来说，他还得叫一声菲姐……算盘，最后还是打到了自家人身上。看着唐逸扛着绣春刀进了沈园，萧棣抬头无语看苍天。贼老天，专逮着我玩是吧？两人进了沈园，宁川便脸色阴沉拦住了去路。“妈的，一处的人都快忙疯了，你们俩还挺悠闲是吧？”宁川抬手掐着唐逸和萧棣的后脖颈，将两人拎到角落里：“你们俩让一处配合你们，计划呢？阴谋呢？”“你们好歹告诉我，你们到底想干嘛？想怎么干？”宁川额上有虚汗，皇帝的圣旨来得太突然，他们连一点准备的时间都没有。以至于看似密不透风的严防死守，其实漏洞百出，进入沈园的这数百人，根本就没时间逐一排查，鬼知道里面有多少敌人。妈的，要是出现意外，后果不堪设想。这两个兔崽子，是在拿他们的九族别在裤腰带上玩呢！
content_en: At the same time, the Dongyu Embassy.Dong Yuzheng asked Yan Feng to pour a cup of tea and pushed it in front of a young man in white clothes who was so handsome that he was almost eerie."Qin Yu, I know it's hard for you to come to Dayan day and night, but now I don't have much time for you to rest." "Today is the Shen Yuan Poetry Festival, and the Emperor of Dayan and prominent figures in Kyoto will participate." "I need you to step on everyone in Dayan, you...can do it?" Qin Yu, one of the most famous talents in Kyoto, Dongyu.She also has an unknown identity, the third princess of Dongyu and Qin Shujian.Qin Yu held the tea cup and frowned after listening to Yan Feng's words: "I have already read the information you sent back on the way here. The others are fine, but this little Shixian doesn't have any information." "It has been so long, haven't you even found out who the little Shixian is?" Yan Feng's face trembled, and he said, "I haven't found out who the little Shixian is."Emperor Yanwen hid him very well and even threw out a false target like Tang Yi to confuse the public."And Tang Yi is just the good-for-nothing son of Tang Jing, the Minister of Civil Affairs.""The real Xiao Shixian is almost dead."During this time, countless forces in Kyoto were trying to find out who the Xiao Shixian was.But all the people sent to investigate Xiao Shixian were killed by Jinyiwei and Yuqiansi.No arrest, no interrogation, just one word, kill!Qin Jue pondered for a moment and said: "That's all, if you don't have it, you won't have it. Today I want to see what kind of person the little poetry fairy is who can write such impassioned poems." "Prepare the car, let's go to Shen Garden." Yan Feng waved his hand, and the servants outside the door immediately went down to prepare the car."Prepare the car, I am going to the Shenyuan Poetry Recital." In the East Palace, the prince put down the books in his hands, looked at Hong Zhu and said with a smile: "Today, we are going to see what Tang Yi, who is recommended to me by his father and can conquer the world, is really capable of." "Back then, at the celebration banquet of Tang Painting in Tianxiang Tower, heHe didn't give Gu the slightest face, which caused Gu to be scolded by his father."Today, Gu will see him being stepped into the dust with his own eyes."Hong Zhu said with a respectful smile: "Your Highness will definitely get what he wants."At the same time, the Minister of Revenue, Liu Wen, and the Minister of Punishment, Zhao Ke, also started to go to Shen Yuan.Therefore, before noon arrived, the entire Shen Garden was already bustling and noisy.Jinyiwei Qianhu Ningchuan led the people from No. 1 to personally approve the invitations and identities of all the people attending the banquet. They were very busy and sweating profusely.At this time, Tang Yi and Xiao Di were still sleeping hugging each other in the carriage. They worked too late last night and returned to Prince Yan's Mansion at almost dawn. After sleeping for less than an hour, they were woken up to wash up.The two of them could only let the palace's carriage drive slowly, get some sleep on the carriage, and regain some energy.Otherwise, if the two of them appeared at the Shen Yuan Poetry Club with panda eyes, how could they become a joke?...Half an hour later, Tang Yi and Xiao Di finally arrived at Shen Garden."Brother, you're here, I've been waiting for a long time." Tang Yi got out of the car with a yawn, and a small figure threw himself into his arms, knocking him back two steps."What? We haven't seen you for two days, and you miss your big brother so much?" Tang Yi smiled and bent down to hug Tang Yin. Xiao Di saw that Tang Yin's exhaustion was gone, and his eyes turned to Tang Yin: "Uh, your sister?" "Yes, my sister." Tang Yi pointed at Xiao Di,Introduced to his sister: "This guy is the fourth prince of the dynasty, King Yan Xiao Di. If you have any difficulties in the future, feel free to look for him." Tang Yin's big eyes fell on Xiao Di and she sweetly called out: "Hello, brother Yan King, I am Tang Yin." Xiao Di glanced at Tang Yi, you are so rude!The little girl has already been summoned by her brother Yan Wang, so she must be given a meeting gift.He groped around his body, and found that apart from the embroidered spring knife and the jade pendant that symbolized his identity, there was only twenty taels of silver left in his body.Give money?Tsk, I can't handle twenty taels... He simply took off the jade pendant from his waist and handed it to Tang Yin: "Yin'er is so good. Here, it's a meeting gift from Brother Yan Wang." Tang Yin did not accept it and looked at Tang Yi.Tang Yi smiled and said, "Yin'er can make his own decision on such a small matter." Tang Yin immediately smiled, took the jade pendant and said sweetly: "Brother gave it to me, I don't dare to refuse, Yin'er thanks Brother Yan Wang." "No, you're welcome..." Xiao Di's eyebrows jumped as he watched Tang Yin take the jade pendant and carefully put it together with a dragon-shaped jade.Let me go. If I read it correctly, is that the jade pendant of my father?Father actually gave his jade pendant to Tang Yin?That is equivalent to a gold medal to avoid death!"Miss Du, thank you." Tang Yi looked at Du Lingfei who was standing in front, nodded slightly and said, "Miss, you have worked hard to take care of Tang Yin these days, I..." "As long as you agree with me." Xiao Di grabbed Tang Yi's words.Tang Yi's mouth twitched sharply, and Du Lingfei's face couldn't help but get hot when she thought of Tang Yin's words today.She looked at Xiao Di and tried hard to maintain the smile on her lips: "We haven't seen you for a long time. Your Highness, King Yan, is still so casual. It seems that the Concubine Xian is right. Your Majesty is still too indulgent." "When I return to the palace later, I think it is necessary to report to the Queen..." Xiao Di's expression suddenly froze.I went, why did I bring a complaint?Du Lingfei had already taken Tang Yin from Tang Yi's arms and turned around to enter Shen Garden.Tang Yi raised his hand and patted Xiao Di's shoulder, gloating a little: "You didn't expect it, right? My sister is still so young, hahaha..." How could Tang Yi not know what Xiao Di was thinking?If you hook up with my sister, then I will hook up with your sister. But Tang Yin is too young, so she can only shift her target to Du Lingfei.But Du Lingfei is the female officer of Concubine Xian. In a sense, he has to call her Sister Fei... The abacus finally fell on his own family.Seeing Tang Yi carrying Xiuchundao into Shen Garden, Xiao Di raised his head and looked at the sky speechlessly.Damn it, you just wanted to catch me for fun, right?When the two of them entered Shen Garden, Ning Chuan blocked the way with a gloomy expression."Damn, the people in No. 1 are going crazy. You two are quite leisurely, right?" Ning Chuan raised his hand and pinched the backs of Tang Yi and Xiao Di's necks, and carried them to the corner: "You two asked No. 1 to cooperate with you. What's the plan? What about the conspiracy?" "Tell me, what do you want to do? How do you want to do it?" Ning Chuan had sweat on his forehead. The emperor's imperial edict came so suddenly that they didn't even have time to prepare.So much so that the seemingly airtight defense was actually full of loopholes. The hundreds of people who entered Shen Garden had no time to check one by one. Who knows how many enemies were inside.Damn, if an accident occurs, the consequences will be disastrous.These two bastards,
